name: bootstrap_confidence_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional and FII directional orders create persistent 5-second return autocorrelation that lasts 5-15 minutes as TWAP/VWAP algorithms steadily absorb liquidity. A block bootstrap CI (90%) built from the last 120 five-second log returns (10-min window) being entirely above zero means: accounting for the serial correlation structure, the positive directional bias is statistically robust — not a single-bar spike diluted in the average, but a sustained regime. When this condition fires on NIFTY, the same institutional order flow that created the statistical significance still has inventory to deploy, making the next 30-90 seconds of continuation probabilistically favorable. The CI width adapts naturally to current volatility regimes — wide in choppy markets (few signals) and narrow in trending markets (more signals), creating a self-filtering mechanism without explicit regime detection.
core_signal_oneliner: 90% block bootstrap confidence interval of the last 10 minutes of 5-second log returns is entirely above (or below) zero, confirming statistically significant directional bias
